verdict.rationale: Greptile is an AI code review agent, so acting as an MCP client is a fair question. The evidence only documents Greptile's own MCP server, which lets external agents like Cursor and Claude Code fetch Greptile comments. That is the server role and does not show Greptile can connect to user-supplied MCP servers. Nothing in the pack shows Greptile loading or calling third-party MCP tools.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can plug MCP servers into this product so it can use their tools
